scope: CVG-003 account-aware BillingService, authenticated billing HTTP routes and first-party financial/payment/event/inpatient/inventory/worker callers

criteria.description: BillingService encounter/record reads, lazy creation, item operations, status updates and settlement require account scope and fail closed before disclosure, cache publication or mutation.
criteria.limitations: The proof is repository-local and bounded to the explicit service contract; arbitrary future in-process callers must use the account-aware surface.

criteria.description: Hydration, authoritative listing and item reads filter account and record/encounter linkage, and an authoritative empty repository result clears stale hot-cache items.
criteria.limitations: The polymorphic source entity itself is not independently resolved by BillingService; the bounded residual is recorded below.

criteria.description: Authenticated billing routes and first-party financial, payment, event-consumer, inpatient, inventory and worker callers forward the authoritative account scope, while foreign route access remains non-disclosing.
criteria.limitations: Only reviewed first-party callers in this authority are covered; no claim is made for future external consumers.

criteria.description: Focused service tests, bounded database integrations, complete API regression, worker rail, workspace typecheck/build and official coverage pass after the contract migration.
criteria.limitations: Local verification does not certify remote CI, target, production, release or distributed operation.

criteria.description: Dependency and secret security, OpenAPI, namespace, migration-source, RLS, deploy-surface, Helm static validation, targeted lint, formatting and diff hygiene pass.
criteria.limitations: Workspace lint retains the unrelated pre-existing counterSales no-control-regex baseline; remote CI and release gates remain open.

criteria.description: The first independent review findings are remediated and a fresh independent review approves the bounded implementation without actionable correctness or security findings.
criteria.limitations: The approval is bounded and explicitly accepts the polymorphic source-entity residual under the first-party caller and out-of-scope constraints.

criteria.description: The child result is reconciled without promoting CVG-003/global ERP readiness, Vetus parity, clinical parity, providers, target operations, production, deployment, release or other modules.
criteria.limitations: Global ERP remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion remains BLOCKED.

gaps: No independent source-entity resolver was added for polymorphic BillingItem source references; first-party callers are scoped and resolver/schema redesign is outside this authority.
No claim is made for schema/migration changes, settlement/cash redesign, providers, target, production, deployment, release, remote CI or global ERP readiness.

Treat sourceEntityType/sourceEntityId ownership as a future resolver/schema hardening item if arbitrary direct source references become supported.

authority.scope: Repository-local account-aware BillingService boundary, authenticated billing HTTP routes and first-party financial/payment/event callers

Adding a source-entity resolver or expanding settlement/cash semantics
